title: Brickwork & Blockwork
activity: Brick and block walls, ties, DPCs, movement joints
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Wall matches the sample panel / benchmark (bond, joints, colour)?
Line and level established for the wall?
Ask the fitter: Where are the movement joints, and who fire stops the head? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Straightness within ±5 mm in any 5 m length?
Verticality within ±10 mm up to 3 m (±14 mm up to 7 m)?
Bed joints level within ±11 mm over 5 m; wall thickness within ±10 mm?
Cavities clean, ties in and clean (no mortar bridging), insulation tight?
DPCs and cavity trays lapped, lintels with at least 150 mm bearing each end?
Movement joints in, clean and sealed?
Head restraints fitted; mortar laid at 5°C or above?
Point at the same level within ±10 mm across the wall?
DPC/cavity tray laps at least 20 mm onto surrounding elements?
Wall ties at max 900 mm horizontal / 450 mm vertical, and at 300 mm vertical within 225 mm of openings; embedded at least 50 mm?
questions.source: Approved Document A / BS EN 845 standard tie spacing – confirm engineer spec

questions.q: Brick/block protected from rain and frost overnight, no washed-out mortar?

notOk.t: Blockwork built over a movement / VI joint
Fire stopping at the head missing or incomplete
Pointing incomplete, loose blocks, cracked beds
Mortar snot on floors and doors not cleaned
